memory_candidates.content: An optional metadata field that is documented in a format/schema doc but instructed in NO agent contract is never emitted in practice. Verified instance: proposed_file_scope on .return-meta.json is fully specified in context/formats/return-metadata-file.md (producer, consumer, ownership, path form) and consumed by update-task-status.sh --file-scope-add, yet `grep -rln proposed_file_scope agent-system/extensions/*/agents agent-system/extensions/*/skills` returns ZERO hits -- no agent is ever told to set it, and no observed research dispatch has. When planning any new agent-populated metadata field, the schema section is necessary but not sufficient: pair it with an explicit, conditional instruction in the producing agent's own metadata-writing stage, or the field ships dead.
